text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [DoGatchmon] & [Timemon]: Cost 0 (If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.)

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Security A. +1＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost. [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 3 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.) [When Linking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.
